newsitem.title: UK: EMI shares squeezed higher in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: EMI shares squeezed higher in thin trade.

text.p: EMI Group Plc shares were squeezed higher in thin volume on Monday, with the Guinness Plc and Grand Metropolitan Plc merger enough to revive old bid rumours around the music publisher, dealers said.
The stock was up 66p or 5.4 percent at 12.87-1/2 stg by 1450 GMT in volume of 1.1 million shares, after earlier rising as high as 12.88 stg -- its highest since January 29.
"There are just some old bid rumours," said one market-maker in the stock. "It is nothing specific, it is just the one they are picking on today."
Dealers pointed out that EMI shares are often volatile with the price susceptible to large swings on relatively small volume.
Dealers also highlighted Pearson Plc, up 31p or 4.3 percent in volume of 1.3 million, as another long-rumoured bid candidate whose shares were stimulated by the Guinness-Grand Met combination.
